description: Model Context Protocol server manifest. Ships with safe defaults and placeholders. Secrets are referenced by env var name only — never inline.

filesystem.safety: Bound to WORKSPACE_DIR; cannot traverse above it.

github.flag: FLAG-1: requires a scoped token; disabled until provided.

fetch.safety: Read-only HTTP; subject to egress allowlist.

browser.safety: Headless, sandboxed; enable only when a task needs live web interaction.

database.flag: FLAG-1: requires connection string; disabled until provided. Prefer read-only role.

memory.safety: Ephemeral per-session unless a persistent store is configured.

policy.least_privilege: Enable only the servers a task declares. Network servers are gated by the environment egress allowlist.
policy.secrets: Never inline credentials. Reference env var names; inject at runtime from a secret manager.
policy.audit: All MCP tool calls are logged with server name, capability, and rationale.
